key_insight: TreeC learns understandable residential energy-management strategies with competitive performance against model predictive control and reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: Coordinating batteries, heat pumps, EV charging, and photovoltaic systems can lower household energy costs, but implementation costs remain a barrier.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine learning controllers.
Develop TreeC to learn understandable energy-management strategies.
Evaluate methods in three simulation cases and one real-world experiment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive TreeC performance across diverse problems, but both TreeC and model predictive control performed worse on real hardware than in simulation.
watch_item: Practical deployment requires representative training data and reliable real-time inputs; average savings did not outweigh current implementation costs and effort.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
